Signed release build of Notch 1.1.

Package `com.exoplanet.notch`, version name 1.1, version code 2, target API 36.

Width is a shared octave fraction from 0.1 to 1.0. Each notch turns that into its own hertz width. Width, on/off, and center frequencies are restored on the next start. Play and Pause sit on the same row as the other audio buttons.

The APK is signed with the upload key.
